text:
The Blues paid two first-round picks at the 2026 draft to bring Mason McTavish over from Anaheim, and 24 games in, he looks like the shooter they bought. He has eight goals on 8.8 expected, right where they should be, 55 shots, and a slick shootout goal that sealed a win.

The points have been a little quieter than the chances. St. Louis has scored 4.1 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice, which usually swings back. At five on five the Blues are even with him on (50% of the expected goals), about the same as without him. He's physical, 32 hits, and All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) puts his primary shot assists at the 80th percentile among forwards. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season in Anaheim. Our range projects 39 to 58 points and 18 to 31 goals.
